judge_reasoning: The model's solution incorrectly treats Brazen Scourge as already on the battlefield when it is actually in hand and never cast (and there is no mana available to cast it after paying for Insult and Hazoret's Favor). It also double-counts damage by having Brazen Scourge deal combat damage while simultaneously being exiled by Identity Thief's triggered ability, which would remove it from combat. These errors make the solution rules-illegal, and even taking the claimed total at face value, 30 damage is far below the optimal 80 damage achieved by the official solution, which correctly leverages Saheeli's -2 ability to copy Combat Celebrant to chain multiple additional combat phases with repeated Hazoret's Favor triggers.
model_solution:
1. Cast Insult (the first half of the split card)
2. Cast Hazoret's Favor
3. Enter combat phase 1. When Hazoret's Favor triggers at the beginning of combat, use its ability to give Combat Celebrant +2/+0 (making it 6/1)
4. Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker
5. Exert Combat Celebrant during combat, generating an additional combat phase and untapping other creatures (Combat Celebrant deals 6 damage, doubled to 12 by Insult)
6. Enter combat phase 2. When Hazoret's Favor triggers again, use its ability to give Brazen Scourge +2/+0 (making it 5/3)
7. Declare Brazen Scourge as an attacker (deals 5 damage, doubled to 10 by Insult)
8. Declare Identity Thief as an attacker. When it attacks, use its triggered ability to exile Brazen Scourge and have Identity Thief become a copy of it (deals 3 damage, doubled to 6 by Insult)
9. In main phase 2, activate Saheeli Rai's +1 ability to deal 1 damage (doubled to 2 by Insult) and scry 1

Total damage dealt: 30
